args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future monster individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: A cute but threatening Seoul gate monster with three broad rounded folded-paper petals joined around one small deep center. Each petal has a soft blunt rounded tip, and the whole creature is a compact clover-shaped mass with no long spear point, no thin fin, no appendages below. Anatomical material: folded ivory paper sheets forming an animated body, thick clean crease edges, blank unmarked surfaces and two inkless cutout eyes. Face: three tiny eyes grouped tightly in the central depression. Single cohesive body silhouette, no legs, feet, knees, humanoid torso, walking joints or articulated limb rig. Front-three-quarter view, restrained inner magic light, thick readable edge and soft painterly shading. A few small material details must explain its theme rather than recolor another monster. Transparent background, no environment, text, props in hands, or ground pedestal. Designed for one shared float motion applied to the entire PNG.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
One cute threatening legless monster. Absolutely NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO WALKING JOINTS, NO HUMAN ARMS. Single cohesive body, full silhouette visible, no floor shadow or ground plane.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered and SMALLER, occupying only 70 percent of the canvas width and height, with generous 15 percent transparent padding on all four sides. Every tip and outer edge must be well inside the canvas. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.
